manual_review_summary: All11 design-note failure groups were checked against implementation/tests; no additional actionable issue remained after the two fixes.
Source closure includes both quote and thesis roots, detects cycles separately, preserves raw SHA and availability receipts, and distinguishes current unknown inputs from malformed references.
Raw-latest CAS plus selected strict-current availability, fixed policy/registered-time and consumed classification versions are saved. Exact request retry precedes latest CAS.
Initial unclear reply classification is not confused with applied public source metadata; original metadata holds survive later public assessments.
Current projection only adds holds for quote timing, thesis/version/receipt/deadline, explicit position and unconsumed classification changes; it does not promote historical unresolved results.
Only new table/Harness/CLI wiring added. Old reply JSON/schema and RecordAvailability entity taxonomy stay unchanged; no numerical financial policy or valuation calculation was introduced.

reviewed_demo_summary.comparison_limit: Prices differ before and after the reply; this is not an estimate of IR effectiveness.

reproduction_code.nonpositive: Use tests.test_research_decisions fixture. Copy saved market source under new ID, set both source.metadata.price_jpy and decision_quote.price_jpy to0/-1; remove explicit position declarations; old ResearchDecisions.add_review saves1 unresolved row. New code raises ValueError and saves0.
reproduction_code.legacy_raw: Copy valid market source under new ID, remove metadata/requires_research, put price/observed_at into content JSON; bind quote paths into content and save source through lowlevel Store with receipt. Old add_review raises KeyError(metadata); new code saves using validated copies while raw SHA/receipt remain exact.
reproduction_code.pure_comparison: Load preserved before/src/ir_agent/decision.py under ir_agent package with importlib.util; compare evaluate_decision/evaluate_ir_plan returned objects or exception type/message on22+3 fully synthetic representative cases.

limits: Functional and manual contract review, not exhaustive proof, financial meaning/assessment truth, source authenticity, brokerage position verification or investment performance.
Future/current trusted-clock injections and limited preexisting fixture SQL were used only inside memory fixtures; no production database or old DB copy was opened.
Prior producer29+old78 and fixed32 logs remain historical producer checks. Reviewer did not rerun the full suite; parent owns final full-suite acceptance.
Root synthetic demo compares different prices before/after a reply and does not estimate IR effectiveness.
New source/price collection, automated trading/dispatch, historical-write/performance APIs and broad database corruption hardening were not added or audited.
